resources.name: Disconnect Entity List
quotes: In addition, we use the Disconnect Entity List [2] to get the entities of online tracker domains.
Moreover, we group redirectors’ domains by the organization to which they belong using the Disconnect Entity List [2].
In order to understand which companies track users on ad destination pages, we group the domains that observed tracking resources are served from by “entity” using the Disconnect Entity List [2]
references: [2] Last accessed September 11, 2023. Disconnect Entity List. https://github.com/mozilla-services/shavar-prod-lists/blob/master/disconnect-entitylist.json
resources.used_in_paper_reasoning: The authors use the Disconnect Entity List in Section 3.2 and Section 4.2.2 to map tracker domains to their parent organizations for their analysis.
